title: CDEP Agent: Connecting Meteorologically Detected Temporal Compound Events to Real-World Documentary Evidence
abstract: arXiv:2608.28628v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Compound drought-to-extreme-precipitation (CDEP) events are recognized in climate science as a growing driver of extreme impact, but whether this recognition carries over into real-world early warning and post-event documentation is unknown, so a meteorologically real CDEP event may pass with neither advance warning nor any later record. Here we present CDEP Agent, an auditable LLM-agent framework that tests this mismatch directly by linking CDEP candidates detected from meteorological reanalysis to real-world hazard and impact evidence across sources with different spatial scales, temporal resolutions, and reporting conventions. translated_title: CDEP Agent：将气象学检测到的时序复合事件与真实世界的文献记录证据相连接
translated_abstract: 干旱转极端降水复合事件在气候科学中被认为是日益增长的极端影响驱动因素，但这种科学认识是否延续到了真实世界的早期预警和事后文档记录中尚不清楚，因此一个气象学上真实存在的CDEP事件可能在既没有提前预警、也没有任何事后记录的情况下悄然过去。本文提出了CDEP Agent，一个可审计的大语言模型代理框架，通过将气象再分析数据中检测到的CDEP候选事件与来自不同空间尺度、时间分辨率和报告惯例的真实世界灾害与影响证据相连接，直接检验这种不匹配现象。以加利福尼亚州为案例研究，我们从2021-2025年的ERA5观测数据中识别出408个候选CDEP事件，并沿五个维度对每个事件进行评估：前期干旱、极端降雨、本地影响、灾害-影响归因以及可解释性。
tldr: 提出可审计的大语言模型代理框架CDEP Agent，将气象再分析数据中检测到的干旱转极端降水复合事件与真实世界的灾害和影响记录证据相连接，揭示了气候科学认知与实际预警和文档记录之间的脱节。
en_tdlr: CDEP Agent is an auditable LLM-agent framework that links meteorologically detected compound drought-to-extreme-precipitation events to real-world hazard and impact evidence, revealing the gap between climate science recognition and actual early warning and post-event documentation.
